messages:
Liam (Sales): Heads-up — customer (EdgeTrans Logistics) asked for a private deployment (VPC + on-prem fallback). They want a firm timeline and an acceptance checklist by EOW. Can product triage?
Maya (PM): Thanks. Key asks from sales: 1) VPC-only private control plane, 2) optional on-prem airgapped bundle, 3) FIPS KMS + HSM support, 4) 99.9% latency SLA for inference endpoints. Any immediate red flags?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Quick notes from intake call: customer will mandate no egress from on-prem. They'll provide a CIF (Customer Infra Form) next week with network ranges. Major deps: KMS/HSM procurement, on-prem GPU availability, maintenance window for install, and SCIM-based SSO.
Anya (Eng): No red flags yet but two technical caveats: 1) airgapped on-prem requires our offline installer + signed images (we need legal sign-off on distro), 2) FIPS/HSM path touches our secrets flow — needs security review. Rough estimate: 6–10 engineering weeks after CIF, assuming standard hardware.
Ben (Customer Success): FYI they flagged compliance reviewer — will require weekly status updates and a short eval plan: "baseline perf tests + sample prompts". They asked for a go/no-go gate after staging verification.
deploy-bot: created ticket PRJ-2307: "EdgeTrans private deploy intake" assigned to product-triage. (link: https://tracker.redwood/prj/2307)
Maya (PM): Let's capture launch acceptance criteria in this thread. Draft acceptance criteria (for triage):
```
- Control plane accessible from customer's VPC (mutual TLS or private link)
- Secrets managed via customer KMS/HSM; no plaintext secrets stored
- Inference endpoints meet 99.9% uptime and median p95 latency under agreed threshold in staged env
- Offline installer (airgap) validated in customer lab with install docs + checksum-signed images
- Audit logs forwarded to customer's SIEM or retained per 90-day policy
- Rollback path defined + runbook for escalations
```
Maya (PM): Devon / Anya — can you confirm feasibility of each bullet and call out any missing work items?
Devon (Solutions Eng): Confirm feasibility but callouts: (a) mutual TLS private link we support, but need networking playbook for their infra team; (b) HSM integration: we support common HSMs (PKCS#11) but if they use a proprietary vendor we'll need an adapter (~2w); (c) staging perf tests — we'll need a canonical prompt set from them.
Anya (Eng): Add: container image signing + offline installer automation (~1.5w). Kernel optimizations for their GPU shape may be extra scope — mark as post-MVP. I'll add a sizing action: @Maya can you attach expected concurrency and token/sec?
Maya (PM): Asked for CIF with concurrency numbers. For backlog: priority = P1 for enterprise onboarding track. I'll tag PRJ-2307 with `/triage` and `/private-deploy` and create two subtasks: "network/KMS check" and "airgap install validation".
Liam (Sales): Customer target launch window = 10 weeks from CIF. They're willing to sign a dedicated contract if timelines met. If on-prem stretches, propose interim dedicated-hosted in their VPC via VPC peering as fallback.
Ben (Customer Success): I'll coordinate weekly stakeholder reports. Also confirm they require SOC2 + FIPS notes in contract.
Devon (Solutions Eng): Fallback plan: dedicated-hosted + VPC peering is doable in ~3 weeks after contract. Good to propose as contingency in SOW.
Maya (PM): Next steps: (1) Sales to upload CIF by Tue, (2) Solutions to run network/KMS compatibility runbook within 3 business days of CIF, (3) Eng to produce rough capacity estimate and airgap effort estimate within 5 business days. I'll update PRJ-2307 with checkboxes.
Anya (Eng): I'll run quick capacity calc once CIF is in. If anyone has sample token/avg latency targets, drop them here.
Liam (Sales): Dropping initial numbers from customer: 80 concurrent streams, avg 150 tokens/sec, p95 latency target 250ms.
Maya (PM): Noted. Closing loop — will follow up in PRJ-2307. :white_check_mark:
Devon (Solutions Eng): +1. Marking post-MVP kernel tuning as low priority for initial rollout. :thumbsup:
Ben (Customer Success): Adding weekly sync to calendar — invite sent. :calendar:
